'''Vorrik's Folly''' was the name [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] jokingly considered for the debris field [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Esfandia/Legends|Esfandia]] be christened, after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] commander [[B'shith Vorrik]], who had [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Battle of Esfandia]].
